requiredFindings.title: The capture API does not establish the promised single source-read boundary
requiredFindings.detail: Section 1 assigns every source read to snapshot.rs, but C1a2 gives candidate_custody.rs a put(source: &mut dyn Read, ...) operation that streams and hashes the supplied source. Passing the handed source File directly moves the consuming read loop into candidate_custody.rs, outside the proposed two-file source pin. Conversely, CaptureSession::read(path) must capture B2/C2 inputs before the extent walk, but the only specified descriptor-opening surface is the completed-extent walk visitor. The plan does not explain how those earlier reads obtain custody-judged descriptors without a host path-string open or a second traversal rule.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Define the complete pre-walk capture boundary. Keep actual source-descriptor reads in snapshot.rs, with candidate custody accepting chunks/a sink, or explicitly specify an adapter that preserves that read site. Add a security-owned retained-root relative opening/re-observation service usable before the extent walk, under the same custody and charging rules. Pin all relevant reader/opener modules and add a pre-capture/reuse/change control that proves no second source read.

requiredFindings.title: The walk entry accepts only durable writer authority
requiredFindings.detail: walk_snapshot requires &ProjectOperation. That type is the writer handoff, lending its root through operation_handoff.rs:380 under the durable receipt/lease. Existing project_chain.rs explicitly supports a separate read lending through installation_read.rs ReleasedRead::discovery_root. M3-J1 item 6 forbids an ephemeral request from acquiring a writer lease or entering the ordinary writer, and also requires the positively-absent-installation route. The plan promises the library for J2b and J2c but gives no lawful root input for either ephemeral case.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Specify a narrow root/custody input with authenticated durable and ephemeral construction routes, including the released-read route and the positively-absent-installation premise. Keep the lease requirement specific to durable requests, with no fence during either walk. State which existing closure files each route needs to change and include route controls without wiring a production caller.

requiredFindings.title: The interim VCS gate must also cover D15 Git members
requiredFindings.detail: LD-C1A-5 only describes withholding sealing for a Git-tracked project. Under M3-C item 4, a D15 workspace root is NoRepository/kind none while its admitted member repositories are Git; such a workspace requires the schema-3 VCS observation with all members. This plan already walks admitted D15 members, but does not explicitly withhold sealing when the root is NoRepository and member VCS observations are still unavailable. Root kind none alone cannot authorize a schema-2 snapshot that omits those members.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Make SnapshotVcsPending cover every input requiring C1b, including any admitted D15 Git member, not just an enclosing root Git repository. Permit the interim none observation only with authenticated NoRepository and no members requiring observation. Add a NoRepository-root-with-Git-member control that refuses sealing until C1b.

requiredFindings.title: The ledger constructor precedes the derivation of its required byte cap
requiredFindings.detail: C1a1 is to introduce snapshot_profile with the derived byte cap, but C1a4 is where the pricing recipe and cap derivation are supplied and reviewed. There is no stated cap or derivation prerequisite for C1a1, nor an explicit incomplete intermediate API. Choosing a placeholder discovery/global cap would violate the stated snapshot profile; changing it later also moves the whole-file work_ledger.rs census pin again.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Move the pricing recipe and initial cap derivation ahead of or into C1a1, leaving corpus margin measurements and the gated blind refresh for C1a4; alternatively explicitly scope C1a1 as an incomplete internal primitive with no claimed finished snapshot profile. Account for all retained/cumulative charges and read attempts, and name every later cap/closure change and receipt-staleness transition. Do not infer a full work-cost bound solely from final inventory path bytes.
